note: On Lake Sakakawea near Garrison. A few West loop sites sit on the bluff above the lake; the other loops are set back in open, tree-lined rows. Full-service marina with gas dock and restaurant, swim beach, boat ramps, fish-cleaning station, camping cabins and the Guardhouse interpretive center. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks confirm 140 sites (48 premium FHU $30/$35 Sat, 56 modern 50-amp + water $25/$30 Sat, 18 modern group, 1 premium group, 17 primitive tent) with showers, flush toilets, dump; counts agree exactly. Electric 50 added, max_rig 95; groups manual; note trimmed. Lakeview stands (west bluff sites ~60-90 m and ~10 m above the lake). Pin ~500 m off the sites.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. The closest sites are on the West loop bluff: 82 (47.59209,-101.42878) and 89 (47.59166,-101.42870), DEM ~574 m. On Esri imagery (winter, lake frozen) the ground falls away over an eroding, brushy bluff; DEM 568 m ~65 m west of 89 and 556 m ~115 m west, so at a normal Sakakawea pool (~561-565 m) open water is ~70-90 m from the pads and ~10 m below them. Open view, not on the water. Every other loop is 300 m+ back. The stored evidence ('loops set back ~300m') missed the bluff sites but the call holds.

MAX LENGTH PLACEHOLDER: reserveNDparks posts Pad Length equal to Pad Width on 32 premium sites (North loop 125-139 = 14 ft; South loop 140-162 = 12-14 ft); these are plainly the width copied into the length, not real limits. North loop 109-124 post 55-75 ft. East loop posts 48 or 50 ft on all 51 sites (near-uniform, possibly a placeholder). West/Middle 38-95 ft. max_rig_ft written as 95 (a West loop modern site).

BASE: modern $25 base; all 17 primitive sites are 'Primitive Tent Site' units ($15, grass, 0-28 ft). POLICY ROW consistent (Saturday +$5 on modern and premium confirmed). Stored reservation_fee 6 / entrance duplicate the state:ND row; left as stored.
